$comment: Global switchboard. Everything that is not clinic copy lives here: domain, branding, theme, feature toggles, analytics. Edit this file first when you set up a new clinic.

theme.$comment: Set these four hex values and the entire site recolours. Every tint, shade, border, icon and shadow is derived from them at runtime — no Tailwind rebuild, no CSS edits.
theme.$overrides: Optional. Any key here wins over the derived value. Use only if a derived tint is not right for your brand.

fonts.$comment: Pick from the curated pairs in lib/fonts.js. Anything else falls back to the default pair.

features.$comment: Turn whole capabilities on or off without deleting code or breaking links. A disabled route is removed from the nav, the sitemap and the footer, and returns 404.

announcement.$comment: Thin bar above the header. Set features.announcement to true to show it.
announcement.text: Now open on Sundays, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM.

analytics.$comment: Leave blank to load nothing at all. No third-party script is injected unless an id is present.

images.$comment: Remote image hosts must also be listed in next.config.mjs. Local files in /public need no entry.

openGraph.$comment: Leave image blank to auto-generate a branded card from the clinic name and tagline.
